content.title: Jim Lembesis: The Wizard of Elevator Mechanics
content.caption: A skilled elevator mechanic who has been repairing and upgrading lifts for over 47 years.

slides.heading: Jim Lembesis: The Wizard of Elevator Mechanics
slides.text: A skilled elevator mechanic who has been repairing and upgrading lifts for over 47 years.

slides.heading: The Problem
slides.text: A shortage of lift and escalator mechanics in the US, which is also a problem in many other countries, has gotten worse over time.

slides.heading: The Solution
slides.text: Offering better tax breaks to companies that train lift mechanics could help ensure that plenty of workers continue to enter the industry.
